notes.coal: One unit of Coal is required for each smelting operation, regardless of the material or duration.
notes.raw: raw: false means the ingredient can be made from other items; `via` is the recipe or conversion id to expand it with. Coal, ores, wood, stone, hardwood, Battery Pack, Pine Tar etc. are raw (gathered or produced by a non-recipe machine).
notes.any_of: Ingredients with any_of accept any one of the listed items (Wild Seeds) or any fish; they are not expanded.
notes.yield: yield is the number of items one craft produces; when neither the Crafting page nor the item page states a count, it is 1.

conversions.name: Copper Bar
conversions.evidence: is created by smelting 5 Copper Ore in a furnace with 1 coal for fuel.

conversions.name: Iron Bar
conversions.evidence: is created by smelting 5 Iron Ore in a furnace with 1 coal for fuel, or by Crafting the "Transmute (Fe)" recipe (3 Copper Bars into one Iron Bar which is unlocked at mining level 4).

conversions.name: Gold Bar
conversions.evidence: is created by smelting 5 Gold Ore in a furnace with 1 coal for fuel, or by transmuting 2 Iron Bars into one Gold Bar.

conversions.name: Iridium Bar
conversions.evidence: is created primarily by smelting 5 Iridium Ore and 1 Coal in a Furnace.

conversions.name: Radioactive Bar
conversions.evidence: is crafted by smelting 5 Radioactive Ore and 1 Coal in a Furnace.

conversions.name: Refined Quartz
conversions.evidence: is created by smelting 1 Quartz in a furnace with 1 coal for fuel.

conversions.name: Refined Quartz
conversions.evidence: 1 Fire Quartz can also be placed in a furnace with 1 coal to produce 3 Refined Quartz.

conversions.name: Refined Quartz
conversions.evidence: Broken CDs can be recycled into Refined Quartz.

conversions.name: Refined Quartz
conversions.evidence: Broken Glasses can be recycled into Refined Quartz.

shop_prices.name: Bait
shop_prices.evidence: Bait is used to reduce the delay before a nibble on a fishing rod by 50%. It can be purchased from the Fish Shop after reaching Fishing Level 2 for 5g each, crafted after reaching Fishing Level 2, grown in a Worm Bin, or found in Fishing Treasure Chests. It may also randomly appear at the Traveling Cart for {{Tprice|1}}.

shop_prices.name: Coal
shop_prices.evidence: The Blacksmith sells Coal for 150g during Year 1 or 250g from Year 2 onwards.

shop_prices.name: Copper Ore
shop_prices.evidence: Can be bought at the Blacksmith for 75g each in Year 1 and for 150g each in Year 2+

shop_prices.name: Gold Ore
shop_prices.evidence: Blacksmith for 400g each in year 1, 750g each in year 2+.

shop_prices.name: Iron Ore
shop_prices.evidence: Can be bought at the Blacksmith for 150g each in Year 1 and for 250g each in Year 2+

shop_prices.name: Oil
shop_prices.evidence: Oil is a cooking ingredient made from the Oil Maker. It can also be obtained from Pierre's General Store for 200g. Pierre sells Oil in his shop at the Desert Festival for 4 Calico Calico Eggs. 2-4 Oil may occasionally be found in Supply Crates on the Beach Farm provided the player has upgraded the Farmhouse at least once.

shop_prices.name: Solar Essence
shop_prices.evidence: Solar Essence is a Monster Loot item which is dropped from the Ghost, Iridium Bat, Metal Head, Metal Head (dangerous), Haunted Skull, Squid Kid, Squid Kid (dangerous), Mummy, Hot Head, and Blue Squid. Krobus also sells 10 a day for 80g each. Sunfish may randomly produce a Solar Essence in a Fish Pond when the pond population reaches 10 fish.

shop_prices.name: Stone
shop_prices.evidence: The price of stone at the Carpenter's Shop increases from 20g to 100g starting in Year 2. The player will receive a letter in the mail on Spring 1 of Year 2 saying "Notice: The price of raw materials at Robin's shop and Clint's shop has increased." The gold obtained by selling stone to Robin or through the Shipping Bin is unchanged.

shop_prices.name: Void Essence
shop_prices.evidence: Void Essence is a Monster Loot item which can drop from Shadow Brutes, Shadow Shamans, Shadow Snipers, Haunted Skulls, Serpents and Spiders. Krobus also sells 10 a day for 100g each. A Void Salmon Fish Pond may produce 5-10 Void Essence when the population of the pond reaches 8.

shop_prices.name: Wood
shop_prices.evidence: The price of wood at the Carpenter's Shop increases from 10g to 50g starting in Year 2. The player will receive a letter in the mail on Spring 1 of Year 2 saying "Notice: The price of raw materials at Robin's shop and Clint's shop has increased." The gold obtained by selling wood to Robin or through the Shipping Bin is unchanged.
